events.title: My Face on the Astronaut
must_haves: The astronaut's face is recognizably the woman from portrait-woman.jpg.
The replacement face fits inside the open helmet without conspicuous seams or doubled features.
The original white suit, helmet and star background remain intact.
The result retains the retro poster look and vertical composition.

answer_sheet.Target: The astronaut's visible face in poster-astronaut.jpg.
answer_sheet.Style and preservation: Keep the original retro poster style, suit, helmet and star background.
answer_sheet.Size and platform: Keep the vertical 9:16 poster shape; free-tier size is fine.

events.text: That’s me in the park photo I’ve attached, and I’d like you to put my face on the astronaut in the attached poster. I thought this would be a fun way to imagine myself in one of those old space posters. What I mean is to replace the astronaut’s visible face with mine from the park pic, keeping the vertical 9:16 poster shape, and a free-tier size is fine. Please keep the original suit, helmet, stars in the background and retro poster look. I’m a little worried about losing the charm of the original poster in the process. Please don’t add any text.
